---
title: Modular monolith
description: pouryakit-modular-monolith, several Modules in one Host, each reached through its Gateway.
---

## What it is

`pouryakit-modular-monolith` generates one Host of [Modules](/docs/reference/glossary#module): the Proving Sample's Catalog with `Catalog.Contracts`, Billing, Inventory, and Ledger, a Stream Module, with `Ledger.Contracts`. Each Module has a Composition Root of its own, an `IModuleDefinition` the Host adds with `AddPouryaKitModules`, and its endpoints send through the Module's [Gateway](/docs/reference/glossary#gateway).

<Callout type="warn" title="Calls between Modules stay in-process">
  Integration Events and Snapshots go through the Host's Outbox, and a question goes through the owning Module's Contracts. Modules of one Host never call each other over HTTP.
</Callout>

## When to use it

When the application has, or soon will have, more than one business boundary, and they deploy together. It also shows each way Modules talk: Catalog publishes what Inventory and Billing receive, Ledger keeps its accounts as a [Stream](/docs/reference/glossary#stream), and Catalog's agent runs on the AI Capability.

## Generate and run it

<Steps>
<Step>

### Generate it

```bash title="Terminal"
dotnet new pouryakit-modular-monolith -n Acme.Shop
```

</Step>
<Step>

### Migrate each EF Core Module

Run it as [Your first Host](/docs/get-started/first-host) runs the monolith, and migrate Billing (`BillingDbContext`) and Inventory (`InventoryDbContext`) the same way as Catalog. Ledger needs no migration: Marten creates its tables itself.

</Step>
</Steps>

## What it composes

| | Stated in |
| --- | --- |
| The monolith's Capabilities, with Streams, AI and `PouryaKit.Modularity` | [What each composition composes](/docs/capabilities/templates#what-each-composition-composes) |
| Ledger's Marten store joining the Host's message store | [Streams](/docs/capabilities/stream#registering) |
| A cross-Module effect in the smoke test: a product Catalog creates opens its stock item in Inventory | [The smoke test](/docs/capabilities/templates#the-smoke-test) |

## Failure messages

<Accordions>
  <Accordion title="A declaration without its Module">
    A declaration left on `builder.Services` in a Host of Modules fails the Host when it is built, naming its form on the Module's builder and the form that names the Module.
  </Accordion>
  <Accordion title="A ConfigureContainer after AddPouryaKitModules">
    It replaces the container the checks install, and the Host fails when it starts, naming the call.
  </Accordion>
</Accordions>
